synthesis.problem: On the Scout driver map, the topmost / most-recent entry in the Live Hits Pending Repossession stack does not open hit details when tapped, while older entries in the same stack do. Reproduced live on a Premier Adjusters demo (2026-09-16) as a Scout user.
synthesis.outcome: Every Live Hits row (and any map marker that represents the same hit) must open the Hit Details bottom sheet on click, including the newest entry, on desktop and in-vehicle (compact) viewports.

scope.summary: Frontend click/selection path for Live Hits Pending Repossession on the Scout map (driver + shared overlay). Root-cause the first-row / newest-hit miss; fix without workaround; pin with a regression test or browser assertion.

proposed_changes.change: Ensure Live Hits list rows are fully clickable (z-index / pointer-events / keying); keep selectHitFromCard → mapStore.focusHit.
proposed_changes.reason: This is the Live Hits card stack (top-left) named by the ticket.

proposed_changes.change: If desktop overlap is confirmed: keep --scout-controls-h measurement honest and/or lower stacking so controls cannot steal clicks from Live Hits rows.
proposed_changes.reason: Controls sit at z-[25] above Live Hits z-20 by design (ScoutHome comment); height CSS var is the only gap.

proposed_changes.change: Only if focusHit/selection semantics are wrong for newest hits (e.g. silent no-op on missing fields).
proposed_changes.reason: focusHit always setSelectedHit today; recenter is optional when lat/lng present.

out_of_scope: Changing recentHits ClickHouse query semantics / disposition rules unless the payload is proven to omit fields that block opening
Bird's Eye-only admin chrome unless the same overlay bug reproduces there

notes: Live Hits list: DashboardOverlay.vue @click=selectHitFromCard → mapStore.focusHit → setSelectedHit + optional pan.
ScoutControlsWidget is z-[25]; Live Hits column is z-20. Desktop Live Hits top offset uses var(--scout-controls-h). Compact hides the controls widget and pins Live Hits at safe-area+12px.
Stale comment in DashboardOverlay still says Live Hits are hidden in adminMode; code shows them (DEV-2137 restored). Not this bug's cause.
recentHits payload includes id, scan_id, lat/lng (nullable), images, vehicle fields. focusHit opens the sheet even when lat/lng are null.
List :key=hit.id — prefer scan_id if id collisions ever appear; not yet proven.
Precedents: DEV-2200 (same card payload), DEV-2292 (overlay pointer-events), DEV-2106 (top-left overlay collision with Live Hits).

leading_hypotheses.title: Desktop overlay steal
leading_hypotheses.detail: ScoutControlsWidget (z-25) overlaps the top of Live Hits (z-20) when --scout-controls-h underestimates height — first row(s) receive no click.
leading_hypotheses.fits: Most recent = top row; older rows further down still work.

leading_hypotheses.title: Map icon vs list row confusion
leading_hypotheses.detail: Newest hit's logo marker sits under/near the Live Hits panel; click hits non-interactive overlay chrome while older list rows work.

leading_hypotheses.title: Live poll / key churn on newest row
leading_hypotheses.detail: Polling replaces recentHits; unstable key (hit.id) on the newest row drops the click handler mid-tap.
leading_hypotheses.fits: Newest-only; less likely if id is stable CH id.
